'''Hoverdale's Hideout''' was the base of operations of the conman [[Andro Hoverdale]] and [[Hoverdale bandits|his bandits]] in the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooinian]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]]. It was a deep [[Cave/Legends|cave]], filled with all kinds of machinery, stolen [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and crates.

Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] sent by the [[Azure Cabal]] member [[Propti Xaroon]] entered the cave and [[Death/Legends|killed]] several of the bandits to retrieve Xaroons's belongings that had been stolen by Hoverdale [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier.

==Behind the scenes==
Hoverdale's Hideout was a location in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. The cave could be found in the desert of the planet Tatooine. It was added to the game along with the Azure Cabal quest line with [http://starwarsgalaxies.station.sony.com/players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007 Chapter 6: ''Dangers of the Wild''] in May 2007. To complete a mission for Propti Xaroon, the player had to enter the cave and kill bandits until the location of Xaroon's old pouch inside the cave was revealed.
